chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Take a spouse, for it is more conducive to sustenance for you."

key_terms.أَرْزَقُ: More conducive to provision and sustenance
key_terms.اِتَّخَذُوا: Take or adopt; here, an instruction to enter marriage
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.لَكُمْ: For you; indicating benefit to the addressees

ai.seo_question: How does marriage relate to increased sustenance in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages marriage and presents it as a means through which Allah increases sustenance. It highlights the positive worldly benefit of forming a household alongside the broader virtue of marriage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4345 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Take a spouse, for it is a means of increasing your sustenance."
